description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it and Blasting Station trigger
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Academy Researchers trigger, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
